name: wifi_status
summary: Report the Wi-Fi radio's power state and the network it is currently joined to (if any).

name: list_preferred_wifi
summary: List the preferred (remembered) Wi-Fi networks this Mac will auto-join, in priority order. Note: listing nearby/available networks to join is not supported (it requires elevated privileges on current macOS) — use open_settings (pane 'wifi') to pick a new network.

name: bluetooth_status
summary: Report whether Bluetooth is powered on and which devices are currently connected.

name: power_status
summary: Report power and battery state: the current power source, battery charge and charging status, and whether Low Power Mode is on.

name: open_settings
summary: Open a specific pane of System Settings for the user. Use this to hand off actions this server cannot perform directly because they need administrator rights — e.g. connecting/re-enabling a printer, joining a Wi-Fi network, toggling Bluetooth, or changing battery/Low-Power settings. Runs immediately; cannot be undone (it just opens a window).

params.name: pane
params.description: Which System Settings pane to open.
